contexts.text: They appear with a ghastly face... SE 5200.
In the light of Heaven, their faces are... ghastly, like those of corpses...
The face of the satan became first ghastly...
When evil Spirits flow in with their ideas... their ideas appear living, but are as it were ghastly, being devoid of life. This livingness or ghastliness is, in itself, dead...
They appear, in that light, like ghastly corpses. SE 5229:end. AE 554:3.
